content: It is in the shelter of each other that the people truly live.
author: Celtic & Norse Proverbs
sourceWork: Ar scáth a chéile a mhaireas na daoine — Classical Irish Seanfhocal
explanation: Against the damp, freezing gales of the Atlantic, solitary isolation meant swift death. Human beings are designed to be trees standing together in a grove, interlocking roots beneath the soil and blocking the wind for one another. We exist to be shelter for our neighbors.
practicalInsight: Be an active shelter for someone today: provide a safe space, offer emotional warmth, and protect them from cruelty.
reflectionPrompt: Who has been an unselfish shelter in your storms, and who is currently sheltering under your branches?
